positive_global_styles: instrumental cinematic documentary score for a premium YouTube guide about the novels of Stephen King
key of D minor, around 96 BPM unless stated otherwise
felt piano, music box, warm cello and string pads, soft analog synth pulses, tight modern percussion, subtle sub bass
